mentions.name: Simple Machines Made Complicated
mentions.description: An interactive book in which each page is a working mechanical mechanism, like a book full of fidget toys. A follow-up to the author's earlier book 'Simple Machines Made Simple', it devotes one page to each of the six simple machines and their progressions to complex machines (e.g., wheel to gears), including a planned more complex pulley example that must fit within a 5mm page thickness.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a book starring the 6 Simple Machines. I already did one book called "Simple Machines Made Simple." I'm now doing a follow up book that I'm thinking will likely be titled "Simple Machines Made Complicated" (or maybe Complex). Each page is a working mechanism. Kind of like a book full of fidget toys.
